title: New MSFS 2020 PC Activities Are Here! A320 Captain Missions & Historic D‑Day Flights
description:
Stop flying the same routes! 🛑 This week's MSFS Marketplace update brings HISTORIC D-Day missions and a brand new A320 "What-If" Southwest pack that changes everything. From realistic Turkish Airlines operations to unique hidden gems in Koschi’s Unique Places Part 8 & 9, your flight sim just got a lot more interesting. Stick around to see the new Winter 2025 schedules for Vancouver and Vienna!

🗺️ New activities added this week (PC)
The following activity (missions & miscellaneous) was newly released in the marketplace this week:

🗺️ Perfect Flight: 4AIR MISSIONS – A320 SOUTHWEST WHAT IF (Creative “what‑if” airline mission scenarios)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: A320 Captain – Turkish Airlines (Realistic airline operations and routes)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: History by Air – D‑Day – The Normandy Invasion (Historic WWII‑themed flight experience)
🗺️ Koschi: Unique Places – Part 8 (Scenic discovery flights to lesser‑known locations)
🗺️ Koschi: Unique Places – Part 9 (More hand‑picked unique destinations to explore)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline Schedules – AAY [Winter 2025] (Real‑world airline schedules)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline Schedules – CAL [Winter 2025] (Seasonal airline operations)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline Schedules – IBE [Winter 2025] (Iberia‑style route planning)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline Schedules – LAN [Winter 2025] (South American airline schedules)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline Schedules – OMA [Winter 2025] (Middle Eastern airline operations)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – CYVR [Winter 2025] (Vancouver airport traffic realism)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – LOWW [Winter 2025] (Vienna airport schedules)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – NZAA [Winter 2025] (Auckland airport operations)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – OKKK [Winter 2025] (Kuwait airport schedules)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – WMKK [Winter 2025] (Kuala Lumpur airport traffic)
